related.title: Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程
related.titleEn: Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「數位儀控的多樣性要求」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Diversity requirements for digital I&C" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首座開工的 EPR：熔融物滯留裝置、數位儀控多樣性與起動試驗；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程則以大型預製件吊裝、海底冷卻水隧道與高潮差海堤的土木工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first EPR to start construction: core catcher, digital I&C diversity and start-up testing; Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering centres on civil engineering of heavy prefabricated lifts, subsea cooling-water tunnels and a sea wall for extreme tides, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「半速汽輪機與末級葉片」的模型移到Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海底冷卻水隧道與取排水頭」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Half-speed turbines and last-stage blades" to Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subsea cooling-water tunnels and intake and outfall heads", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「數位儀控的多樣性要求」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Diversity requirements for digital I&C" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering must be respecified.

related.title: 台山核電廠 EPR 機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「數位儀控的多樣性要求」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；台山核電廠 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Diversity requirements for digital I&C" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Taishan EPR Units must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首座開工的 EPR：熔融物滯留裝置、數位儀控多樣性與起動試驗；台山核電廠 EPR 機組則以全球首部商轉的 EPR：1,750 MW 級發電機、蒸汽產生器與燃料完整性監測為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first EPR to start construction: core catcher, digital I&C diversity and start-up testing; Taishan EPR Units centres on the first EPR in commercial operation: a 1,750 MW-class generator, steam generators and fuel-integrity monitoring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「半速汽輪機與末級葉片」的模型移到台山核電廠 EPR 機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Half-speed turbines and last-stage blades" to Taishan EPR Units, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「數位儀控的多樣性要求」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；台山核電廠 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Diversity requirements for digital I&C" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Taishan EPR Units must be respecified.
